title: Timing: Parallel-Prefix Adder
constraints: Timing budget: at most **12 logic levels**. Ripple carry needs 33, and even the synthesizer's built-in `+` operator needs 16.
hints: Per bit, compute generate `g = a & b` and propagate `p = a ^ b`. The carry into bit i is 1 if some lower bit generates and every bit in between propagates.
Group (g, p) pairs with the associative operator `(g_hi, p_hi) ∘ (g_lo, p_lo) = (g_hi | p_hi & g_lo, p_hi & p_lo)`.
Kogge-Stone: combine at distances 1, 2, 4, 8, which is log₂(16) = 4 prefix levels. Fold `cin` into bit 0's generate. Then `s = p ^ {carries, cin}`.
